propositions: test_contended_index_lock_cleared_during_backoff_succeeds fails intermittently on macOS py3.13 CI under load while passing on Linux legs
test uses a wall-clock threading.Timer to delete a planted index.lock, but timer can fire while git commit holds its own real index.lock, causing deletion of git's lock mid-commit
force_reclaim=True in _with_index_lock_retry bypasses age gate and reclaims the test's planted lock on first retry, leaving a window for git commit to create its own real lock before timer fires
replacing threading.Timer with gitutil._retry_probe deterministic probe allows lock release after observed retry attempt rather than wall-clock elapsed time
test must prove contended young live-peer index.lock released mid-retry is ridden out and write succeeds, without risk of deleting git's legitimate lock
